title: Superellipses, Lanes, Goo & Top-Layer Menus
description: Five live drops: a scroll-timeline corner-shape morph, a JS masonry lane packer, gooey SVG-filter text, a cursor-tracked sheen, and native Popover API menus.

drops.title: Scroll Shapeshift
drops.description: Panels morph into view purely on CSS scroll timelines, with corners animated as a live superellipse curve.
drops.concept: Uses animation-timeline: view() to scrub each panel's entrance from scroll position alone, no IntersectionObserver. Where the new corner-shape property is supported, corners animate through superellipse() values for a squircle-to-spike morph; everywhere else a scale/blur fallback keeps the effect visible. A separate animation-timeline: scroll(root) bar shows total scroll progress.
drops.source: CSS-Tricks tutorial on scroll-driven corner-shape animations

interaction.mouse: scroll the page to trigger panel entrances
interaction.click: drag the debug sliders to change the corner-shape morph range
interaction.touch: scroll normally; entrances fire on view crossing

drops.title: Lane Masonry
drops.description: A vanilla-JS wall packer that reimplements the shortest-lane heuristic behind CSS's emerging native masonry layout.
drops.concept: CSS is gaining native masonry via Grid Lanes (item-flow: column wrap dense) — items pack into the currently-shortest column instead of a fixed row grid. This drop rebuilds that packing algorithm in plain JS so you can see and tune it: adjust lane count and gap and watch bricks of random height redistribute into the shortest lane each time.
drops.source: CSS Grid Lanes / native masonry proposal, MDN Masonry layout guide

interaction.mouse: drag the lane-count and gap sliders
interaction.click: click Reflow bricks to reshuffle heights
interaction.touch: sliders respond to touch drag on desktop-width viewports

drops.title: Gooey Morph Type
drops.description: Words liquefy into the next word through a single SVG Gaussian-blur plus contrast-matrix filter.
drops.concept: A goo filter blurs overlapping outgoing/incoming words, then a steep feColorMatrix alpha slope snaps blurred edges back to full opacity or fully transparent — the classic 'gooey' blob technique applied to type instead of shapes, so a headline, a status label and a tag all melt between states instead of crossfading.
drops.source: Magic UI's Morphing Text component (gooey SVG-filter technique)

interaction.click: drag Blur radius / Cycle speed sliders to retune the filter
interaction.touch: purely visual, no touch input needed

drops.title: Cursor Sheen
drops.description: A soft radial highlight pinned to the exact pointer position, swept live across a card grid and a row of pills.
drops.concept: On every pointermove the cursor's position relative to each element's own bounding box is written into --px/--py custom properties, which drive a radial-gradient pseudo-element via calc(). Because the math is per-element, the same two lines of JS light up an entire grid of independent cards plus a row of pill buttons at once.
drops.source: Brittany Holmes' 'A shiny-on-hover effect that follows your mouse' CSS technique

interaction.mouse: move across any card or pill to sweep the light
interaction.click: tune spot size / intensity in the debug panel
interaction.touch: tap a card to center the highlight at the touch point

drops.title: Top-Layer Menus
drops.description: A dropdown, a right-click context menu, and a self-dismissing toast, all built on the native popover attribute.
drops.concept: The HTML Popover API promotes any [popover] element to the browser's top layer, handling stacking, light-dismiss and focus return for free. This drop shows three uses: an auto-dismiss dropdown menu positioned under its trigger, a manually-positioned right-click/long-press context menu, and a popover="manual" toast that closes itself on a timer, with @starting-style driving the entrance animation.
drops.source: Chrome for Developers, 'Introducing the popover API'

interaction.mouse: click Actions to open the dropdown, right-click the dashed zone for the context menu
interaction.click: click Fire toast to trigger the self-dismissing toast
interaction.touch: long-press the dashed zone to open the context menu
